original_ai_output.title_zh: 冈比亚将用出售前独裁者美国豪宅所得赔偿其统治受害者
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 冈比亚表示将把出售前总统在美国的豪宅所得的250万美元用于赔偿其统治时期的受害者。美国司法部称，将把出售前独裁者叶海亚·贾梅在华盛顿一处房产的收益归还冈比亚。贾梅被指在其22年统治期间主导谋杀政治对手、失踪、强奸和酷刑。

key_facts.fact: 冈比亚称将用出售前总统美国豪宅所得的250万美元赔偿受害者
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Gambia said on Tuesday it will use $2.5 million dollars from the sale of the former president's mansion in the United States to pay reparations to victims of his rule.

key_facts.fact: 美国司法部称将把出售贾梅华盛顿房产的收益归还冈比亚
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: In September, the US Justice Department said it would return proceeds from the sale of a Washington property owned by former dictator Yahya Jammeh to The Gambia.

key_facts.fact: 贾梅被指在22年统治期间犯下谋杀、失踪、强奸和酷刑等行为
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Yahya Jammeh is accused of presiding over the murder of political opponents, disappearances, rape, and torture during his 22-year rule.

uncertainties: 贾梅所受指控尚未经本报道证实
目前仅有一个来源（Africanews）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
